data.name: Nuria
data.gender_notes: Nuria is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'nur' meaning 'light' in Arabic. In Islamic tradition, it represents enlightenment and guidance. The name Nuria carries the meaning “Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuria usually hope their child will grow to embody light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies 'light from Allah' in Islamic spiritual context.
data.etymology: Nuria belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuria total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نوريا
in_arabic.long_meaning: نوريا هي اسم مشتق من نور والضياء، وهو مصدر قوي من الله في القرآن، ونوريا تعني الضوء والضياء والنور، وهي تشير إلى الهداية والرشاد في الحياة الروحية

in_urdu.name: نوریہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوریہ کا مطلب نور اور روشنی کی علامت ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور قرآن میں بھی نور کا ذکر آیا ہے، نوریہ کا استعمال برصغیر کے مسلمانوں میں بکثرت ہے

in_hindi.name: नूरिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: नूरिया नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ प्रकाश और ज्ञान का प्रतीक है, यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमानों में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, और इसका धार्मिक महत्व भी है

in_pashto.name: نوریا
in_pashto.long_meaning: نوریا د نړۍ له رڼا څخه یو څرګند مثال دی، دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او د افغانستان او پاکستان د مسلمانانو په منځ کې ډیر شهرت لری

in_english.name: Nuria
in_english.long_meaning: Nuria is a name derived from Arabic roots, meaning light and spiritual guidance, it is a popular name among Muslims worldwide, and has significant cultural and spiritual importance in Islamic tradition

pronunciation.urdu: نوریہ کا تلفظ نو ریہ ہے
pronunciation.hindi: नूरिया का उच्चारण नू री या है
pronunciation.pashto: نوریا د تلفظ نو ریا ده
